The timing on Task 1 and Task 2 essays depends on your test (IELTS/TOEFL) for the IELTS test Task1 writing is 20 minutes and Task 2 writing is 40 Minutes. For the TOEFL Task 1 (Integrated Writing Task) is 20 minutes and Task 2 (Independent Writing Task) is 30 minutes. 

For Business English - The 30 min lesson would be anything 500 words or less and the 60 Minute is for longer documents like PPT. Pricing may vary depending on complexity and length of the task. Feel free to send me a message with any questions.

pro_course_detail.description:
This lesson type is for those wishing to improve their ability to naturally speak the English language. This can also include improving your ability to read in English, as well. Conversations will ultimately be based around the goals of the student - there is no single defined structure for every lesson because every student is different. Other students prefer to focus on a specific topic or have a specific goal in mind (a future interview, job presentation, meeting, etc.). I consider myself to be rather flexible in what I do on iTalki. 

During the lesson, I will be constantly listening to your English and offering corrections, suggestions, or new words and expressions. Many of these will also be typed out. If I notice consistent mistakes or major grammatical errors, additional focus can be placed on correcting those mistakes. I am also open to any questions you may have regarding English (grammar questions, questions about something your read or watched, questions about slang, etc.). 

Ultimately, the goal of these lessons is to improve a student's confidence and comfortability in speaking with a native speaker. Speaking with anyone in a foreign language can be very intimidating at first, but it is my hope that you will feel comfortable and able to speak freely without fear. This is not a judgement zone. 

** PLEASE NOTE that I do NOT teach children. I believe that teaching children requires particular experience. I recommend that you look for one of the many great professional teachers or community tutors on iTalki who have experience teaching children and especially beginners. 

If you are interested in purchasing a package of lessons but have not yet spoken to me, please contact me beforehand so we can discuss your goals and desires for the lesson.

course_info.trial_description:
Welcome to Your Personalized Trial Lesson!

Are you ready to take your language skills to the next level? In this 30-minute trial lesson, we will work together to create a learning experience that is uniquely tailored to your goals. Whether you're learning for travel, business, exams, or just personal enrichment, this session is the perfect starting point to help you reach your objectives.

Here’s what you can expect:

Introduction (5-10 minutes):
We’ll start by getting to know each other. I’ll ask a few questions about your language learning background and your goals. This will help me understand your current level, any challenges you’ve been facing, and what areas you would like to improve. By taking this time to learn about your unique situation, I can personalize the rest of the lesson to suit your needs.
Mini-Lesson (15-20 minutes):
This part of the lesson is where we’ll dive into a short, engaging activity based on your goals. If you’re focusing on conversation skills, we’ll have a dialogue where I’ll correct your grammar, pronunciation, and fluency. If you need help with grammar, we’ll go through an easy-to-understand explanation, followed by practical exercises. For those preparing for exams, I can provide tips and sample exercises to build your confidence. Regardless of the focus, you’ll experience a hands-on, interactive lesson designed to boost your language abilities.
Feedback and Future Plan (5 minutes):
At the end of the trial lesson, I’ll give you specific feedback on your strengths and areas for improvement. We’ll talk about the next steps in your learning journey and how I can help you achieve your goals. You’ll leave the lesson with a clear understanding of what you need to work on and a customized plan for future lessons with me.

pro_course_detail.title: Basic English with Conversation
pro_course_detail.description:
This lesson is perfect for beginners or intermediate learners who want to improve their everyday conversation skills. We’ll focus on practical, real-life situations to help you speak more confidently and naturally. I recommend the 30 minute option if your budget is tight. We can do a lot in 30 minutes!

What We’ll Cover:

Talking About Your Day – Start by discussing your daily routine. You’ll learn how to describe your activities and add details to keep the conversation going.
Conversation Starters – Practice essential phrases for small talk, like discussing the weather, hobbies, or recent events.
Expressing Opinions – Learn how to share your thoughts and feelings effectively in simple, natural sentences.
Listening Skills – We’ll also work on responding to others’ comments and keeping the conversation flowing.
Lesson Structure:

Warm-Up (10 minutes): We’ll begin by chatting about your day to help you relax and ease into speaking.
Main Practice (30 minutes): We’ll dive into basic conversation topics. I’ll guide you through speaking exercises, offer corrections, and help you expand your answers to sound more natural.
Feedback & Next Steps (10 minutes): I’ll provide feedback on areas to improve and tips for continuing your practice after the lesson.
Why This Lesson?

If you want to feel more comfortable speaking in everyday situations, this lesson will help. We’ll focus on boosting your fluency, improving your vocabulary, and getting you more confident in conversation. No need to worry about mistakes—I’m here to help you speak with ease and confidence!

Join this Basic Conversation lesson to build your speaking skills and gain confidence in day-to-day interactions. Let's get started on your path to fluency!

pro_course_detail.title: Intermediate English with Conversation
pro_course_detail.description:
Are you ready to take your conversational skills to the next level? This Intermediate Conversation lesson is designed to help you become more confident and fluent in your speaking abilities. Real-life Conversations: We'll focus on practical, real-world topics that are relevant to your interests and goals. These conversations will challenge you to use your vocabulary and grammar in ways that feel natural.

Customizable Lessons: I tailor each lesson to your specific needs. Whether you want to focus on work-related conversations, social interactions, or just building overall confidence, we’ll design the conversation topics that suit your learning goals.

pro_course_detail.title: Advanced/Business English
pro_course_detail.description:
Are you looking to improve your English communication skills for a professional environment? This Business English course is tailored for individuals who need to develop their language skills to succeed in international business settings. Whether you're preparing for job interviews, meetings, presentations, or just want to enhance your overall business communication, this course will help you reach your goals.

Business Vocabulary: We’ll cover the essential vocabulary you need for different business situations, including meetings, negotiations, presentations, and emails. You’ll learn phrases and terminology that are common in professional environments.
Fluent Communication: We’ll focus on improving your ability to speak clearly and effectively in business contexts. You’ll practice both formal and informal business communication to ensure you’re ready for a variety of situations.

pro_course_detail.title: The Sound of American English (Accent Reducction)
pro_course_detail.description:
Do you want to master the unique sound of American English? In this course, The Sound of American English, we’ll dive deep into the specific sounds, rhythms, and intonations that define the American accent. Whether you're just beginning or looking to refine your existing skills, this course will help you speak with clarity and confidence, allowing you to sound more natural in conversations.

What You’ll Learn:
Distinct American Sounds: American English has its own set of vowels and consonants that are pronounced differently compared to other accents. We’ll work on these unique sounds, including the "r-colored" vowels, the flat "a," and others, to help you master the authentic American sound.
Rhythm and Intonation: American English is known for its rhythm and melody, with natural rises and falls in speech. You’ll learn to use intonation patterns that native speakers rely on to convey meaning, emotion, and emphasis.
Word Stress and Syllable Emphasis: Pronunciation is also about where you place the stress in a word. We’ll practice how to correctly stress syllables and words, which is key to sounding fluent and avoiding misunderstandings.
Common American Pronunciation Patterns: Many words in American English are shortened or connected in casual speech. We’ll explore these patterns, such as word linking and reductions (e.g., "gonna," "wanna"), to make your pronunciation more conversational and less formal.
Accent Reduction Techniques: If you’re looking to reduce your accent and adopt a more American sound, we’ll focus on techniques to help you speak more like a native. From practicing subtle changes in vowel and consonant sounds to perfecting rhythm and tone, you’ll learn how to sound more natural in American English.
Listening and Mimicking: A key part of learning pronunciation is listening to how native speakers talk.
